DerivationInfo.description: 1.11.0 (E30a): the declared method of a derived revision (its parents are `parents`/the lineage, not here).
DerivationInfo.title: DerivationInfo

Display.description: Plain words for this item (display.py); identifiers stay in the fields beside it.
Display.title: Display

History.description:
1.4.0: where this exact revision sits in its result's version history (E8).
Current observations (count, head) may grow; number and parent never change.
History.title: History

ImportOrigin.description: 1.9.0: a file imported from a portable bundle — provenance, not authority.
ImportOrigin.title: ImportOrigin

Interpretation.description: The executable identity of the deployed reader; literals name what runs now.
Interpretation.title: Interpretation

LineageEntry.description:
1.8.0: one lineage assertion as a commitment sha256(salt + canonical([predicate, reference])).
Disclosed (predicate, reference, salt) only when the caller may see the other revision.
LineageEntry.title: LineageEntry

LineageReference.description: An exact revision a lineage assertion names; `ophiolite:managed` means another revision of this asset.
LineageReference.title: LineageReference

MethodRecord.description:
1.11.0 (E30a): how a derived revision was made, as its publishing request declared it — the projection of
its interpretation record (E23a's decision family: selected by declaration).
MethodRecord.title: MethodRecord

PackageRecord.description:
1.10.0 (E23a): the source package and recipe a recipe-read revision was read with. The manifest
lists 'package' (the package manifest), 'interpretation' (recipe, decisions, evidence) and one
'companion:<name>' row per companion member; each is readable as a representation.
PackageRecord.title: PackageRecord

Person.description: Who did something: the user id and, when the server knows one, a human label.
Person.title: Person

RecipeInterpretation.description: The executable identity of a recipe reader (Connectors petrel_points / opendtect_horizon).
RecipeInterpretation.title: RecipeInterpretation

RecipeReference.description: A recipe is a project-scoped asset, pinned by asset id and revision (never by a schema version).
RecipeReference.title: RecipeReference

RecordedInterpretation.description:
What was recorded at retention; representable for any past reader version.

The identity is the triple (reader, parsing_policy, mapping); lasio_version is
library evidence that travels with the record. None means not recorded.
RecordedInterpretation.title: RecordedInterpretation

Relationships.description:
1.5.0: relationships the uploader declared, filtered for the caller.
"restricted" means one exists that this caller may not see.
Relationships.title: Relationships

RevisionManifest.description:
1.8.0 (E19, ADR 0016 §1a): what an exact revision is made of. The digest is sha256 of the
canonical JSON of {schema, asset_id, revision, artifact, representations (sorted by id),
lineage (the sorted commitments)}; context and interpretation are inside the representation
bytes it names. Access decisions, labels, heads and times are not part of it.
RevisionManifest.title: RevisionManifest

RevisionManifestV2.description: 1.11.0 (E30a): a /1 manifest plus the declared method, which the digest covers.
RevisionManifestV2.title: RevisionManifestV2

TypedInterpretation.description: The executable identity of the typed reader (Connectors typed_reader).
TypedInterpretation.title: TypedInterpretation

Version.description: How a version reads in words; never derived from polling time.
Version.title: Version

Via.description:
B1(a): the project access key a change was made through, as it was named then (the person stays the author;
this is the route, not a verified application identity). `key_id` belongs under Technical details.
Via.title: Via

WellLocationContext.description: E29: one well's surface point as its file states it (typed-context 1.3.0).
WellLocationContext.title: WellLocationContext
